svg.aria-label: Flagship project: AI-Powered UAV Security Framework. Smart intrusion detection with hierarchical alert management, running on a drone. Mentored by TU Berlin. Pipeline: DJI O4 (camera and video link) → Raspberry Pi 5 (on-board compute) → YOLOv11 (custom-trained detection) → Flask + SQLite3 (backend and storage) → Live web dashboard (monitoring and alerts); the first three stages run on the drone. Features: Custom-trained YOLOv11 detection on board; Zone-based intrusion detection; Hierarchical alert escalation. Publication: IEEE ICADCS 2026, Vikrant University, Gwalior. Accepted, Presented, Published. Areas: UAV security, Edge AI, Computer vision, Autonomous systems.
